name: slack_reply_relocation_japan_kenji
use_case: Pick up a Slack question and post the approved reply in its thread
branch: Kenji Tanaka asked about a relocation allowance for Tokyo in #help-policies (KM07); Oliver Grant provides approval APP-KN-404 to reply in the thread stating no preset allowance applies to Japan under Relocation Policy 1.0 and offering a knowledge request
tests: the agent reads KM07 and relocation_v1, posting that Japan has no preset allowance in Kenji's thread with APP-KN-404
instruction:
You are Oliver Grant, IT Manager. Kenji Tanaka asked in #help-policies whether there is a relocation allowance for moving to Tokyo. Ask the Knowledge Desk to post the approved reply in his thread; you provide approval APP-KN-404.

Your details:
- Name: Oliver Grant
- Employee ID: E08
- Approval: APP-KN-404

persona.name: Oliver Grant
persona.initial_message: Please answer Kenji's question in #help-policies about Tokyo relocation using approval APP-KN-404.

arguments.message: Under Relocation Policy 1.0 section 1, allowances are fixed for the US ($10,000) and UK (8,000 GBP). Other countries like Japan are evaluated case by case without a preset allowance. We can open a knowledge request with the People team if you wish.
